## Where I’m headed

I’m pursuing a career in digital marketing, with a particular interest in the video game industry. I want to combine audience research, content strategy, SEO, and data visualization to build engaging customer experiences.

My coursework has included customer analytics, survey research, digital advertising, and website development. This portfolio demonstrates how I can turn survey results into a clear dashboard and communicate technical ideas through an accessible website.
